newsitem.title: VIETNAM: SOCCER-VIETNAM INTERNATIONAL BANNED FOR LIFE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VIETNAM INTERNATIONAL BANNED FOR LIFE.

text.p: Vietnam said on Friday it had banned
international Chu Van Mui for life for leading an attack on the
referee at the domestic cup final last month.
Soccer officials said Mui's team, Ho Chi Minh City Police,
had been fined $910 and the entire squad, including coaches and
trainers, had been given personal warnings.
Mui's team, all professional policemen, attacked the referee
as the final whistle blew after they had been beaten 3-1 by
provincial side Dong Thap in the televised cup final on October
The referee was kicked and punched and chased round the
stadium. Mui was judged to have led the charge. Riot police ran
on to the pitch to break it up.
A succession of injured players had been carried off and
nine yellow and red cards were shown in a rough and chaotic
game.
Soccer skills in Vietnam have yet to reach international
standards but the game is followed with a passion which on
several occasions has spilled into violence.
The punishment was the second humiliation for Mui. Vietnam's
state media announced earlier this week he had also been demoted
a rank in the national constabulary.
